verdict.rationale: Opting out of usage tracking is a fair question for a public web portal such as the Handelsregister/Unternehmensregister, which could offer cookie or analytics consent controls, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, cookies or any opt-out mechanism. The items cover register search, publication, LEI guidance, email authentication and load notices, none of which relate to tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
